part2.question: Describe a long-term goal/ambition you would like to achieve

segments.v: I want to talk about my long-term goal. I want to start a business to sell handmade products from craft villages in Vietnam. I have had this goal since grade 10. I got this idea when I filmed my grandmother making conical hats. I saw that the workers in her village were old and they earned very little money. Young people didn't want to do this job. I want to help them sell their products online to people in other countries. To achieve this goal, I will study business at university. I will learn about marketing and online selling. Now I already made an Instagram page about my grandmother's hats. I set this goal because I don't want the traditional crafts to disappear. I also want the workers to earn more money.
